meta.title: MAN Lion's City G CNG (A23) Sofia - interior and driver's cab spec
meta.frames: Same frames as src/vehicle/BusSpec.js: x right (+), y up, z backwards (+), forward = -z. 'front' frame origin = middle axle centre on the ground; 'rear' frame origin = rear axle centre on the ground. All y values are ABSOLUTE heights above the ground in metres (floorY = 0.36) unless a key says 'above_floor'.

photos.4: user_ref_4.jpg 1824x1368: front section looking BACK (rearward) towards the bellows; camera ~1.6-1.7 m above the aisle floor; door 2 on the left of the picture (bus-right side)
photos.5: user_ref_5.jpg 1067x800: looking FORWARD to the driver's cab; bus-left (driver side) is the LEFT of the picture

meta.exposure_note: Both photos are under-exposed/cool-cast (white ceiling reads about #a19c90 in photo 5 and #706e6a in photo 4). 'photo_raw' hex = median of sampled pixels; 'albedo' hex = recommended material colour after exposure correction (x1.3-1.5 on lightness, neutralised). Never use photo_raw directly.
meta.supplier_search: WebSearch could not identify the seat supplier or the validator hardware vendor (many queries, EN+BG). WebFetch is blocked for man.eu/auto.cz/automotiveworld/mtc-man (DNS/policy). Seat identified by shell shape and the embossed MAN lion oval only.
meta.confidence_scale: high = measured on a photo and consistent in both photos; medium = measured/estimated from a photo with an assumed scale, or typology with a visible hint; low = typology only / not visible

model.value: MAN-branded hard-shell 'City' bus seat: one-piece light-grey plastic shell (pan + high backrest) with a DARK charcoal cap on top of the backrest that forms an arch-shaped grab handle (through-slot) and carries an embossed oval with a lion silhouette (MAN lion badge) on its rear face.
model.basis: user photo 4 crops p4_seatL_grid/p4_seatpair_grid (front face), photo 5 crops p5_seat_left/p5_seat_right (rear face with embossed lion oval ~0.07x0.045 m); MAN brochure snippet via WebSearch: 'seats are cantilevered with no under-seat props' (older Lion's City brochure)
model.confidence: high for appearance, low for supplier name (Kiel/Fainsa/Ster/Vogel NOT confirmed by any source)

shell_width.basis: photo 4: cap width 275 px at ~2.0 m (f~1300 px) = 0.41-0.44; standard 0.44

double_seat_width.basis: two shells with a 0.01-0.015 m dark vertical gap (visible in photo 4 seatL crop)

centres_x_outer_inner.basis: aisle between double seats about 0.55-0.60 m (photo 4: 330 px/600 px/m = 0.55 m at row A); interior wall face at |x|=1.205

backrest_height_above_pan.basis: photo 4: backrest face = 400 px at 668 px/m = 0.60 m + cap

top_of_cap_above_floor.note: current model is 1.17 = 8 cm too tall

backrest_rake_deg.basis: typology + photo 4 (face tilted back); current model 11.5 is OK

dims_m.backrest_front_surface: concave (dished) - slight lumbar bulge at y 0.62-0.75 above floor and side bolsters; visible curved highlight lines in photo 4

cap_height.basis: photo 4: 120 px / 275 px of width -> 0.19; photo 5: 66/196 -> 0.15

dims_m.cap_lower_edge: shallow smile curve: centre 0.015 m lower than the sides, soft 1-2 mm step to the shell (photo 4)

grab_slot.shape: flat bottom edge, arched top edge (peak +0.015), fully rounded ends R=0.03; passes through the cap from front to back
grab_slot.basis: photo 4: slot 170 px wide of 275 px (62%), photo 5: 138/196 (70%)

top_corner_radius.basis: photo 4/5 cap silhouette is a wide arch

rear_recess_panel.note: slightly lighter rounded-rectangle recess on the BACK face of the shell under the cap (photo 5 p5_seat_left); this is where optional upholstery inserts go

side_profile_polyline_zy.desc: outline of the shell side view, seat-local frame: origin on the floor/podium below the pan centre, +z toward the backrest, y up (above the local floor). Closed polygon. Pan front lip at z=-0.23.

front_outline_xy.desc: backrest silhouette seen from the front (x, y above floor)
front_outline_xy.cap_boundary_y: 0.93 at the sides, 0.915 at the centre

mounting.type: cantilever: pan and backrest are carried by a bracket on the side wall (below the window / on the wheel-arch podium side); no pedestal; floor visible under floor-level seats
aisle_side: rows beside door areas: the aisle-side seat edge is held by a grey vertical stanchion (D 0.04) with a black two-bolt clamp (photo 4 stanchion crop)
front-row right pair (bus-left side, photo 4 x1200-1800): grey tubular C-hoop guard around the aisle edge of the seat from floor to the backrest top, 0.025 tube
podium seats: a small flat L-foot bracket (0.04 x 0.15 m, light grey) under the aisle-side pan corner bolted to the podium top (photo 4 p4_floor_mid at 650,200)
mounting.armrest: aisle-side rows of the left (bus-right) pair have a short padded grey fold-down armrest/bolster flap at the pan's aisle edge, 0.10 x 0.07 (photo 4 at 830-870,1170-1230)

shell.note: light-medium cool grey, satin plastic. Current model #8e9398 is close but looks blue-white because of the env map; keep metalness 0 and envMapIntensity <= 0.4

cap.note: dark charcoal; also the slot interior and the rim. Same colour on both seat faces

materials.rear_embossed_logo: oval 0.07 x 0.045 m, relief 0.001, lion silhouette; skip or draw as a darker oval decal
materials.pan_surface: same grey as the shell (photo 4: #5d6976 shaded), NOT dark navy

where: backrest (and pad) of the flip-up seat in the wheelchair/pram bay on the bus-left wall (photo 4, x1310-1480,y700-920) - whole backrest is moquette, 0.39 wide x 0.52 tall, top corners R 0.08
a second folded seat visible further back at x1040-1090,y640-820 is dark charcoal (probably the same type, low)
NOT on the ordinary fixed seats (all photo 4/5 fixed seats are plain grey plastic, including the red-sticker priority seat)

dots.layout: staggered (hex) grid over the whole surface

waves.description: olive/lime-green wavy horizontal lines, each ~0.004 m wide (varies 0.003-0.005), amplitude 0.012-0.02 m, wavelength 0.16-0.25 m, vertical spacing about 0.055 m (7-8 lines over the 0.5 m back), each line with its own random phase, slight overall tilt of +/-6 deg, some lines fade out toward the edges; a few short bright-green dashes near the edges

procedural_recipe.basis: photo 4 crops p4_moq/p4_seats_right (green line pixels median #47573e raw, 90th pct #7d8c77 raw in shade)

priority_seat.placement: centre of the backrest FRONT face, top edge 0.17 m below the cap (centre ~0.78 m above floor); on the first double seat behind the cab/door 1 on the door side, a smaller copy 0.09x0.20 on the window glass next to it (photo 4 at x225-275,y890-1000)

seat_map.convention: yaw 0 = faces forward (-z), yaw pi = faces backward; floor_y is the ABSOLUTE height of the floor/podium top under the seat; seat pan top = floor_y + 0.445. z = seat pan centre. Same keys as SEATS in BusLayout.js (sec,x,z,yaw,fy,ins) -> fy = floor_y, ins = moquette.
seat_map.capacity_note: Total seat count of the real Sofia A23 G could not be confirmed (generic A23 listings 41-47 seats; EGO-Ankara 18 m CNG: 36 seats / 116 standing). 48 here = 47 plus one optional low-confidence second folding seat (F-LF2); photo-based for the front section, typology for the rear.
changes_vs_BusLayout_js: F-L1/F-L2/F-R1 yaw pi -> 0 (photo 5: they face forward)
folding seat yaw pi/2 -> 0 (pi/2 makes it face the left wall)
F-R5/F-R6: add the aisle seats (right podium is a DOUBLE seat, photo 4)
podium floor_y 0.66/0.62 -> 0.62 both, podium must reach the aisle edge |x|=0.295 (see walls_floor)

standing_areas.note: aisle clear width 0.54-0.60 m between seat blocks (photo 4: 0.55 m at row A); only 0.47 m between the axle-2 podium edges
right side landing between the two yellow stanchions
opposite door 2; pictograms (wheelchair, pram, two blue rule discs) on the left wall glass; grey U-hoop and black-foam horizontal grab rail at y=1.0 frame it
ribbed turntable plate D 1.7 centred on the hitch

grey.note: light-grey powder-coated tube, satin. NOT chrome and NOT blue: metalness<=0.3, envMapIntensity<=0.5 (the current pole material 0xa9adb0/metalness 0.75 mirrors the blue sky and renders blue)

yellow.note: traffic-yellow rails (slightly orange), lemon-yellow floor edge strips

collars_and_clamps.desc: cast pale-grey plastic/alu clamps, ellipsoid 0.075 x 0.06 x 0.05 at every stanchion/rail crossing; black 2-bolt clamp (#16171a) where tubes meet seats

foam_grip.desc: black foam sleeve 0.30-0.40 m long on horizontal grab rails by the wheelchair bay (photo 4 x1290-1555,y880)

vertical_stanchion.basis: photo 4: 25 px at 600 px/m = 0.042; MAN uses 38-40

longitudinal_rails.desc: one continuous rail per side along the whole saloon, above the aisle-side edge of the seats, bolted to the underside of the side duct; the rail's front end bends down 90 deg (R 0.12) into a vertical stanchion at the cab bulkhead / display (photo 5: left end at x285, right end at x810) and the rear end ditto at the bellows portal.
longitudinal_rails.note: current model: x=0.62,y=2.05 straight tube + thin 0.012 hangers every 1.6 m; real rail is thicker (0.032), hung from the duct by short diagonal stays (D 0.025, 0.25 m) at ~1.6 m pitch

candy_cane_arches.desc: most aisle stanchions do not end at the rail: above the clamp collar at the rail they continue as a swan-neck/arch that sweeps outward and up and is anchored in the lower edge of the side duct (photo 5 big arch at x930,y40-280; photo 4 right stanchion at x1240-1580,y10-400).
candy_cane_arches.usage: on every second stanchion (about every 1.6 m); the others simply end in a collar under the rail

vertical_stanchions.rule: grey, D 0.04, floor/podium-top to y=2.05, at the aisle edge of the seat blocks x=+/-0.30 (podium: +/-0.30 on the podium front edge)
vertical_stanchions.note: x=-7.0/-2.35/-0.99 are the YELLOW door-edge poles at x=+0.98 (see below); right-side grey poles are at +0.30. Podium-front poles (z -0.45) end in a white button module (stop request for wheelchair users) 0.04 x 0.14 with two green LEDs at 0.05 above the podium top.
vertical_stanchions.conf: medium for front (counted in photo 4/5), low for rear

horizontal_grab_rails.where: front, bus-left wheelchair bay: horizontal grey tube at y=1.00 from the aisle pole (x -0.30) to the left wall (x -1.20) at z=-2.9, with a black foam grip 0.35 long (photo 4 x1290-1555,y880)
ball-clamp + horizontal tube with black foam grip from the aisle stanchion across the seat back of the axle-2 podium rows, y=1.05, 0.40 m (photo 4 x1120-1240,y730-760)
small D-shaped grey wall handle 0.10 on the sidewall panel beside the first seat (photo 4 x155,y1115), y=0.95

yellow_parts.door_poles: every door has TWO vertical yellow poles (D 0.034, floor to ceiling duct) at the leading and trailing edge of the opening on the saloon side, x=+0.98 (0.22 m inside the sill), z = door.z0-0.08 and door.z1+0.08 (current model OK)
yellow_parts.barrier_arcs: behind the seat row in front of door 2 (and door 1): two crossing yellow tubes forming a barrier: one from the door-side pole top (y 1.05) bending out toward the window pillar and down; second lower tube crossing it (photo 4 x520-770,y750-860; crop p4_door_rail): polyline (x,y,z rel. to the door's leading pole) [0,1.05,0] -> [0.0,1.05,+0.15] arc R0.25 -> [0.25,0.85,+0.45]; and [0,0.80,0] -> [0.30,0.78,0.40]
yellow_parts.door_leaf_handle: yellow curved pull-handle on the inner face of each door leaf frame, 0.9 m long, arc R 0.25 at the top (photo 1 crop p1_door1: arc at the door-1 pillar)
yellow_parts.floor_edge_strips: yellow 0.045 m wide strips on the top edge of every podium (aisle edge and front edge, turning the corner), on the door sill/step edge, and on the cab platform step
yellow_parts.ceiling: yellow oval emergency-release pull 0.05 x 0.03 on the side duct above each door (photo 4 at 660,390), red indicator lamp 0.015 next to it
yellow_parts.grey_not_yellow: all other poles, rails, arches, collars; tube ends have small yellow plugs on some bars (photo 5 p5_right x815,y205)

straps.shape: closed narrow loop of thin grey webbing/cord (teardrop: 0.09 wide at the bottom, 0.36 long), hanging from a pale-grey plastic sleeve clip 0.05 long (#c9ccce) on the rail, plastic ring-less; colour #9aa0a4 slightly translucent; NOT the stiff circular rings of the current model
straps.arrangement: clusters of 3 straps (2 at rail ends) hanging at every stanchion/rail collar, side by side with 0.04 spacing, 0.4-0.5 m below the rail (loop bottom y~1.70); one cluster per ~1.6 m of rail = about 4 clusters per side per section; at the display bulkhead 4 straps

heights.basis: photo 4 camera-height calibration: far ceiling ~2.70 above floor would be 3.06 abs, impossible under roofY=2.96, so take interior height ~2.35-2.40 above the 0.36 floor; window head (windowTopY 2.55) = lower edge of the duct. Current model ceiling is at 2.48 (headroom 2.12 m) = 0.26 m too low

flat_centre.desc: built from large flat panels with hairline seams every ~1.2 m across the bus and ~1.4 m along; a slightly lowered bulkhead header at the cab and at the bellows portal (curved arch, 0.15 deep)

side_ducts.note: sloping, softly convex panel from the flat centre edge down to the window head (photo 4/5). Left mirrors. The panel is light grey #d2d1c9
side_ducts.segments: alternate along z in ~1.0 m panels: [pictogram panel][grille panel] ... separated by hairline seams; the panels follow the slope

grille.desc: rectangular perforated field (speaker/vent grille) 0.55 long x 0.34 wide in the slope, staggered rows of rounded rectangular slots: slot 0.012 x 0.005 m, row pitch 0.022, column pitch 0.017 -> 14 rows x 30 slots; slot colour #3d3f40 raw, albedo darker #4a4c4d; a second smaller 6x4 dot field (0.05x0.04) near the cab bulkhead and near each light
grille.conf: high for look, medium for sizes

side_ducts.pictogram_panel: blue discs D 0.09 (#123a8a, white 'standing passenger holding on' figure), arranged as pairs (two overlapping discs 0.075 apart); 2 pairs per pictogram panel (left side, photo 4 x120-420,y60-250) ; next to the bulkhead one pair + a grey-white 'no leaning on door / hold the pole' hand-pictogram sticker 0.10 x 0.12 (photo 5 x120-205,y205-280)
side_ducts.info_label: white label 0.12 x 0.18 with small text/QR on the right duct slope (photo 4 x1360-1410,y330-390)

light_panels.desc: rectangular frosted diffuser panels, slightly recessed, 0.55 long x 0.14 wide, mounted in the flat centre ceiling in ONE row on the bus-left half at x=-0.38 (photo 5 left of display; photo 4 right of axis) about every 2.0 m (3 visible in photo 5/4); not full-length strips at +/-0.72 as in the current model. Cool white (4000-4500 K), emissive #f4f8ff, intensity ~1.0; a second row on the right is NOT visible.

small_items.what: round ceiling sensor/camera D 0.04 (photo 4 at 1140,212 and 70,320)

convex oval passenger mirror / dome camera housing 0.28 x 0.20, silver, hung under the ceiling above the bellows portal front end (photo 4 x810-915,y340-420) and a smaller one 0.15 further back (x905-950,y490-530); rim yellow/black
roof hatch: NOT visible in either photo (flat ceiling panels only) - leave out, or one emergency roof hatch 0.5 x 0.5 grey at z_front=-2.6 (typology, low)
emergency hammers: red plastic holders 0.10 x 0.04 on the window header at pillar positions (photo 5 at 0-60,295-325 and 1030-1067,340-365), 2 per side, y=2.50, x=+/-1.19
yellow window-release tabs/clips 0.04 x 0.02 on the window header (photo 4 at 1545-1590,y520-555; 630-650,y545-555)
green emergency-exit pictogram stickers 0.06 x 0.12 on the window pillars and door glass (photo 4 at 665-690,y515-545)

lower_panel.desc: light-grey plastic panel from floor to window sill y=1.02, with a 0.06 soft rounded sill ledge on top (#c8cac6)

window_pillars.desc: light-grey, wide, rounded pillars between windows (photo 4 x300-340,y420-800); the previous model draws them thin and black

window_frames.desc: black aluminium frames; each window has a lower fixed pane (sill 1.02 to 1.62) and an upper pane (1.66 to 2.52, sliding/tilt) separated by a black transom 0.07 high (photo 4 left: transoms at y440-470 and y520-560), glass dark-tinted (transmission ~60%)

covering.desc: speckled grey rubber flooring (granite look): base mid-dark grey #5f656c with ~12% light-grey flecks #c4c8cc (1-3 mm) and ~5% black flecks #2c2f33; matte (roughness 0.9). In the photo the aisle floor in light reads #9da1a6-#dde0e5 and in shade #221e21

floor.current_model: floor 0xc9d0d8 x map renders almost black navy: wrong

top_y.basis: photo 4: riser 90 px at 349 px/m = 0.26; arch must clear a R 0.478 wheel

podiums.extent: the podium covers the full width of the double seat: from the wall to the aisle edge x=+/-0.295; in z it spans the wheel arch +/-0.62 from the axle plus 0.15 front/rear: front axle podium z -6.0..-4.3 (axle1 at -5.105), middle axle podium z -0.85..1.30 (axle2 at 0)
podiums.riser: vertical face with R 0.06 rounded outer corner, same speckled grey rubber as the floor (#6a7077); height 0.26; 0.01 grey nosing
podiums.yellow_edge: 0.045 strip along the aisle-side top edge AND the front edge, turning the corner (photo 4 right podium x1075-1210,y840-1040)
podiums.current_model: 0.5 m wide boxes at x=+/-0.97 (outer 0.72..1.22): the seats float, the aisle is 1.44 m instead of 0.55; riser has no yellow strips

aisle_between_podiums_m.basis: photo 4: 165 px at 349 px/m (depth from camera height 1.68 and podium edge 1.42 m below the eye)

turntable.centre: hitch (front frame z=+1.70, rear frame z=-5.07)
turntable.desc: ribbed aluminium plate: ribs 0.012 wide every 0.025 running ACROSS the bus; thin black ring gap 0.015; visible in photo 4 at x920-1065,y900-980; top flush with floor_y+0.01. Current model D 1.9 flat #4b5157 (ok size, wrong colour/texture)

walls_floor.bellows_interior: dark charcoal ribbed tunnel (#26282a) with a lighter ceiling; portal header black arch 0.22 high with 'MAN' lettering in silver (0.20 x 0.05) on the rear-section front wall above the portal (photo 4 at 630-720,y495-515)
walls_floor.rear_platform_steps: inferred (typology): 0.20 + 0.26 high steps with yellow nosing - keep current
walls_floor.cab_platform: driver platform raised about 0.33 above the main floor (MAN: 330 mm), yellow nosing strip on its step edge (photo 5 at 492-503,y786-796)

doors_inside.leaves: two glazed leaves, black frame 0.035, upper and lower glass panes, sealing rubber at the meeting stile (current model OK); green emergency-exit pictograms (2 stacked, 0.06x0.12) at 1.55 on the leaf glass; door-frame header black.
doors_inside.pillars_inside: light-grey wide pillars flank each door (0.11), yellow poles stand 0.22 inside the sill line
doors_inside.request_to_open_button: round or rectangular push-button 0.06, on the yellow pole of doors 2-4 at y=1.05 above floor (red knob with yellow symbol on door 2 pole, photo 4 at 738,845); also doubles as stop request (see devices)
doors_inside.ramp_door2: manual fold-out ramp stored in the door-2 sill; 0.80 x 0.90 plate, yellow edge; not visible in photos (typology, low)
doors_inside.current_model: leaves + yellow handle cylinder 0.9 long on every leaf OK; missing yellow barrier arcs and the second pole structure

interior_display.desc: large landscape LED destination/next-stop display hung from the ceiling at the cab bulkhead, facing the passengers: light-grey rounded-rectangle housing (#d4d3ce, corner R 0.04, frame 0.02) around a black glass face; face tilted 5 deg down toward the passengers
interior_display.basis: photo 5: housing 372 x 82 px; scale from stanchions at +/-0.65 -> 404 px/m -> 0.92 x 0.20 m
interior_display.content: single line of amber dot-matrix text (#ffb12a on #0c0a08), char height 0.035, centred, uses only ~25% of the width for short words; current model: black box 1.1x0.2 hanging at y=2.3 with 2 lines of larger text - too low and wrong housing
interior_display.rear_section: a second identical display at the rear section front wall (z_rear -4.2) facing rearward - typology, low

validators.desc: Sofia e-ticket / open-loop EMV validators (BPC O-CITY + DSK Bank system, ~3,900 validators fleet-wide) are small black/anthracite units on a bracket on the yellow door-side stanchions; one at each door, mounted on the pole at the TRAILING edge of the door opening (rear pole), 1.10-1.25 m above the floor, facing the aisle/doorway; ~0.10 w x 0.19 h x 0.06 d, black bezel, small colour screen top, green/red LED bar, NFC symbol
validators.evidence: photo 1 crop p1_door1 (dark rounded unit on the pole inside door 1 at 185-240,470-540); photo 4 two dark upright blocks at the window pillar by door 2 (370-410,845-910) - low-contrast; vendor of the hardware not found in any source
validators.current_model: box 0.14x0.24x0.1 at y=1.25 with yellow stripe - acceptable position, wrong aspect

stop_request_buttons.type: red round push-button D 0.06 with yellow bell/hand symbol on the yellow door poles at y=1.05 (photo 4 at 725-760,y825-865; raw #c04336)
white/grey module 0.04 x 0.14 with two green LEDs and Braille at the foot of the grey aisle poles on the podium front edge (photo 4 x1120,y1040-1070; p4_stanchion_L)
dark half-disc pads D 0.08 on the aisle poles next to seat backs at y~1.0 (photo 4 at 735-760,y700-800 and 840-860,y690-720) - probably stop buttons or pole hinges

displays_devices.red_emergency: red items in photos are the hammer holders (see ceiling.small_items); door emergency release = yellow oval pull in the ceiling duct above each door

information_stickers.text: Внимание! Седалка за майки с деца, възрастни и хора с увреждания!
information_stickers.where: priority seat backs (first seats behind door 1 and the first double seat in front of door 2) + window copy

information_stickers.text: no-smoking header + 'При нарушения звънете на телефон 02 ... 71 11' + A4 white notice sheet 0.21 x 0.30 with fine print and 6 small icons
information_stickers.where: cab partition glass, passenger side, y 1.40-1.95 (photo 5 at 130-380,y50-340)

information_stickers.text: violet/white round 'Безплатен интернет' Wi-Fi sticker 0.12 x 0.05 and a red-ring 'no mobile phone' sign D 0.05
information_stickers.where: below the notice on the partition (photo 5 at 150-345,y350-405)

information_stickers.text: no-phone/no-smoking round signs D 0.05 (red ring) on the cab glass and the door-1 glass (photo 5 at 700,550; 1020,400)
blue wheelchair disc D 0.10, white pram square 0.10, two blue rule discs D 0.10 with tiny white text, yellow diagonal tape
information_stickers.where: left wall glass at the wheelchair bay, y 1.15-1.40 (photo 4 at 1620-1700,y740-890)

cab.overview: photo 5 (looking forward): driver (bus-left) sits on a platform ~0.33 above the main floor behind a dark-tinted glazed rear partition; to its right a clear driver screen and a small free-standing console; the dashboard is a navy-topped pad across the whole windscreen width; large light-grey panels below.

platform.basis: MAN 330 mm statement (WebSearch snippet, man.eu 'driving comfort') + yellow strip at the console base in photo 5
platform.note: the current model puts the driver's feet and the seat on the passenger floor (0.36)

upper_glass.tint: very dark smoked (#14181c, 85% opaque from the saloon side)

rear_wall.basis: photo 5: black panel 280 px wide = 0.71 m at 392 px/m, tall 550 px = 1.4 m above the white lower panel

aisle_side_screen.desc: clear polycarbonate/glass screen from the console top (y 1.35) to the header (y 2.55) with a black vertical post; the cab 'door' is a clear panel with a grey curved pull handle 0.40 long on the pillar (photo 5 at 410-470,y460-660, light grey)

console.desc: free-standing cabinet right of the driver: navy-blue top shelf (#1f3552 albedo; photo raw #49525f) with rounded front corner and a small black ticket/payment terminal on a stalk, a pen tray; lower body white (#d9dcd8) with a red extinguisher sticker and an 'emergency' black rocker; bottom yellow step strip

top_pad.desc: dark navy/anthracite soft pad running full width under the windscreen, height 1.45 above ground at the front edge (0.76 above the cab platform), depth 0.45; behind/under it light-grey (#cfd2d3) lower panels (photo 5 x530-1000,y670-800 white/pale panels with fire extinguisher bracket (red #b3261e), red bucket, cloth)

dashboard.driver_panel: VDV-style MAN driver's workplace: dark grey (#2b2e33) moulded binnacle in front of the driver with a round/rectangular instrument cluster 0.33 x 0.16 (2 analog gauges, central colour display, tell-tale rows), a lowered side panel at the driver's left (door-control buttons 1-4 + kneeling/ramp + hazard) and an angled panel at the right with rocker switches and the D-N-R pushbutton gearbox selector (3 square keys 0.03, key legends in white)
dashboard.photo_evidence: only the outside view (photo 3 crop p3_windscreen; photo 1 p1_windscreen) and the right dash edge in photo 5: black block with a gooseneck mic on the dash at the right of the driver (photo 3 at 1000-1060,y355-410)
dashboard.ball_knob: black ball knob 0.05 on a stalk at the windscreen base right of the driver (photo 5 at 545-585,y598-632), probably the sun-blind pull or a mirror adjuster

steering_wheel.basis: photo 3: nearly flat ellipse 90x35 px; MAN bus typology

driver_seat.desc: air-suspended high-back seat, dark grey cloth (#2c2f33) with blue/navy bolsters (photo 5 shows a navy seat with a blue patterned cover at 655-700,y735-780), headrest, two armrests; seat pan 0.52 x 0.50 at 0.50 above the platform

sun_blind.desc: dark grey (#4a4d50) roller blind with a diamond/X cord pattern across the upper windscreen, covers the driver-side 55% (x -1.25..+0.10), pulled down 0.45 m from the header (photo 3 crop p3_windscreen at 610-1120,y40-240; photo 1)

ceiling_and_header.desc: cab ceiling light-grey; a closed grey header panel runs the full windscreen width, 0.20 deep, with the back of the front destination sign above it (not visible); the passenger monitoring mirror hangs from it

interior_mirror.desc: elongated convex mirror, light-grey frame (#cfd0cc), shows the saloon; photo 5 at 470-565,y420-460

cab.windscreen_wiper_pivots: two large wipers parked at the screen base (photo 5/3)
cab.current_model_diffs: dash is a black box at the floor; no raised platform; partition is a small white box + dark glass pane at 0.95 wide; console is a floating black box; display too low; no mirror, no sun blind visible from the inside

ambient.look: bright, even, daylight-dominated; interior fill ~35% hemisphere light of the sky colour; ceiling/walls light-warm-grey
ambient.basis: photo 4/5: light panels read neutral-blueish white; saloon is evenly lit with soft shadows

lighting.light_panels: see ceiling.light_panels (single row, bus-left, 0.55x0.14 m, every ~2 m); emissive #f4f8ff intensity 1.0; at night add a RectAreaLight or PointLight 0.9 intensity, 4200 K, range 3.5 m per panel
lighting.other: the ceiling gets a +0.06 emissive (current) - good; the cab has no extra lamp; display amber glows (#ffb12a)
